title: MusicDrop v1.4.4 Available
changelog:
• Up Next Anchored to Bottom: Fixed Up Next queue sheet opening at the top; it now slides up strictly from the bottom as an interactive half-screen sheet
• Transparent Music Controller for Videos: Full frosted glass transparency and dynamic ambient glow applied to the docked player controls in video mode too
• Branded Video Loading Overlay: Replaced YouTube's default play button and loading flash with an official MusicDrop app icon and loading indicator until playback begins
